instruction.name: xvfcmp.saf.s
instruction.description: Compare corresponding single precision elements in `a` and `b`, save the comparison result (all ones if AF(Always False), all zeros otherwise) into `dst`. An exception is raised for QNaN.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Dependent vector-mask chain. Sources are normal float values 1.0 and 2.0.
